text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, the most common type, we give the computer training data. This data includes examples with the correct answers. For instance, we might show it pictures of cats and dogs, each labeled correctly. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it creates. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions on new, unseen examples, such as guessing if a new photo shows a cat or a dog. We then measure the model’s accuracy by checking how many of its predictions were correct. The goal is to make the model as accurate as possible so it performs well in the real world.
